args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects ROUND_HALF_EVEN
but round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP. Fix the rounding mode to match
FIN-212 and the existing docstring.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` asserts banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching FIN-212 and the existing docstring.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.
